headline.purpose: Two-tone step sentence under the top bar.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Pill and round-button hover on desktop.

motion.name: glow
motion.purpose: Top wash brightens with offers and transfers.

breakpoints.name: desktop-min
breakpoints.value: 360px window; pills drop icons when the dock is narrower than their row

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: Black pill for the main action on white or lavender (Accept, Change…).

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Lime circle with an up-right arrow, one per device row.

components.name: Ticket
components.description: White ticket with side notches and a dashed perforation; holds staged items or an incoming offer.
components.css: .ap-dock{background:#2F55E4;border-radius:28px;padding:14px}.ap-ticket{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:16px 18px;font:500 14px Inter,sans-serif;color:#0E0F14;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 11px at 0 62%,transparent 98%,#000) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 11px at 100% 62%,transparent 98%,#000) right/51% 100% no-repeat}.ap-ticket hr{border:0;border-top:1.5px dashed #B9C7F6;margin:12px 0}

rules: Lime is go, cobalt is sending; neither decorates.
Flat: tone separates layers, never shadows.
Offer and status wording comes from core.
